title: Chapter 365: Top Generals Duel
content:
Chapter 365: Top Generals Duel

The blood in his body was about to burst his body.

The Bloodthirsty Spear can absorb 3% of the attack power each time. Although it cannot be digitized in the War General Tower, the blood-sucking effect still exists.

At the same time, the internal force in his body has been exhausted. Instinctively, he will use the Qi-recovering Pill to restore his internal force.

Soon Wang Shuo joined the battle of the top generals.

The top general closest to him was Jiang Mu.

The two did not say anything. The long spear and the short sword collided. In the moment when they passed by, Wang Shuo used "Iron Chain Binding" and a "Backhand Shot" to directly pierce Jiang Mu's chest.

"No."

Seeing his brother being killed, Jiang Song seemed to have recovered a little clarity.

After getting rid of his opponent, he tapped his toes lightly, jumped over suddenly, and kicked Wang Shuo away with a flying kick.

He wanted to go over and hug his brother to see if there was still a chance of rescue, but the instinct of fighting, coupled with the anger in his heart, made him ignore it and kill Wang Shuo directly.

After Wang Shuo was hit, the surging blood in his body calmed down a lot. Although he seemed injured, he was actually fine.

He turned over and got up to deal with Jiang Song who was like crazy.

The battle between the two was extremely dangerous.

As a senior general, Wang Shuo's overall strength was still much worse than Jiang Song, and he was soon seriously injured.

Wang Shuo had to take out the Water of Life to quickly repair his injuries.

But Jiang Song was not relaxed either. Wang Shuo directly adopted a method of fighting with injuries.

As long as Jiang Song gave Wang Shuo a sword, Wang Shuo would definitely fight back.

You punch, I kick.

The injuries on the two continued to increase, but Wang Shuo had the Water of Life, and his body was repeatedly repaired.

Although Jiang Song also had healing pills, the effect was not as good as the Water of Life.

After another blow that hurt both sides, Wang Shuo flew backwards, hit the wall, and vomited blood.

But Wang Shuo's Blood-Weeping Spear also pierced into Jiang Song's head.

This attack directly caused Wang Shuo to be on the verge of death. If it weren't for the last return of some blood and qi to the Blood-Crying Spear, Wang Shuo would have died.

At the same time, Wang Shuo also turned a disaster into a blessing, breaking through the bottleneck of high-level generals and upgrading to a top-level general.

After taking another drop of water of life, Wang Shuo was full of energy again and became even stronger.

But the idea of killing did not disappear.

He took up his gun and rushed into the battle of Baichuan Zhonggu and others.

This battle can be called the highest-level battle in Yingying Town.

After this battle, the pattern of Yingying Town will face a reshuffle.

If everyone was still awake, some of the remaining people would have escaped long ago.

Because they already knew that the so-called strange treasure was simply fake, just an illusion.

But there was no if, the killing continued...

Wang Shuo immediately confronted Zuo Da.

In theory, Zuo Da should be the strongest person in Yingying Town. Wang Shuo had just been promoted to a top-level general, and the gap in strength between the two was undoubtedly huge.

If Wang Shuo had followed his style, he would have escaped long ago.

But now he held the spear in his hand, alert and ready to launch a fatal attack at any time.

Zuo Da had consumed a lot of energy in the previous battle. They tried their best in every attack, and there was no such thing as paddling or retaining strength.

Wang Shuo was in his prime, and Zuo Da's strength had dropped to 70% of his peak.

Although Wang Shuo was at a disadvantage, he was not as embarrassed as he was in the battle with Jiang Song just now.

At this time, the Earth Dragon Beast had been killed by Baichuan Zhonggu. In the entire hall, there were only four people left: Wang Shuo, Zuo Da, Baichuan Zhonggu and Xi Wenhua.
